correctness.rationale: Stratify projective points by exactly s nonzero coordinates. For 1<=s<=n-3 the entire torus (L-1)^(s-1) lies in e_(n-2)=0; s=n-2 contributes zero. For s=n-1 invert all coordinates to a coordinate hyperplane whose torus class is H_(n-1)(L). Full support inversion yields a nonsingular split projective e2 quadric; inclusion-exclusion Q_s through coordinate hyperplanes requires exceptional Q_1=1 and gives the parity-power terms. Every projective component has dimension n-2, while the boundary is <=n-3; full-support section is dense irreducible. Independently recomputed both K0 expressions for n5..12 and the predicted Euler parity laws; direct F7 projective point checks produced 365 at n5 and 3102 at n6, including nonsplit correction.
residual_risks: General Grothendieck-ring identity rests on exact support-stratification/scissor argument, not the bounded n test.
